DeterminationBasis: T14-005 directly establishes a correction-forward chain in which predecessor and successor remain separately identifiable and explicitly linked, while T14-003 rejects silent retrospective rewriting of a predecessor into altered content. Together these existing tests cover NEW_CHAIN_REQUIRED preservation of the predecessor chain rather than rewriting it into the successor.

The existing T08 suite establishes separation of determination from execution, changed-determination lifecycle, bypass resistance, ambiguous-determination failure handling and successor preservation. It does not directly test the positive obligation that a chain-boundary determination itself is explicitly recorded when that boundary materially affects execution, verification or claim scope. That recording obligation therefore remains a distinct test gap.
